classification: retrospective 3+ ranking refinement on already inspected backtests; not independent validation
unchanged_gate: Existing frozen Plan B candidate and ranked-environment qualification, with the recorded historical starting XI treated as confirmed.
selection_frequency: Retain at most three Plan B candidates within each historical weekend.
ranking: 3+ shot hits across the previous five starts descending
average player share of team shots across those starts descending
average player shots across those starts descending
average minutes across those starts descending
target: Player records at least three total shots in the target match.
decision_policy: The ordering above is frozen before computing the reranked target outcomes. Do not add a newly observed threshold or remove misses.
limits: The underlying match outcomes were previously inspected for other analyses, so this is refinement evidence rather than untouched validation.
Historical starting lineups are treated as known before kickoff.
Fixed odds are hypothetical and historical availability is not established.
Same-match and same-weekend selections are correlated.
A separate unused or prospective sample is required before promoting this 3+ ranking.
